note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation, including each chapter's KJV epigraph and the book Q&A's Proverbs 31:25, was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording the first edition carried. The book title keeps its own wording (a title built on Proverbs 31:25 stays the title).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or passage, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. The refrain 'pray without ceasing' is OWB 1 Thessalonians 5:17's «መጸለይን አታቋርጡ». `self_rendered` rows are allusions, indirect speech, the closing prayers' re-personed lines and the chapter's own confession of identity.
